text:
```yaml
name: SBOM Generation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'

jobs:
  sbom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate CycloneDX SBOM
        run: npx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-cli -o bom.json

      - name: Upload SBOM artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sbom
          path: bom.json
          retention-days: 90
```
